article.title: Constructor推出Commerce AEO，把AI引流追蹤接到商品內容修訂
article.title_en: Constructor's Commerce AEO connects AI referral tracking to product-content changes
article.summary: Constructor在11月19日公布Commerce AEO，將AI引流的購物路徑與產品內容建議接在一起。
article.summary_en: Constructor announced Commerce AEO on November 19, connecting AI-referred shopping journeys with product-content recommendations.
highlights: 可按AI來源、商品及類別追蹤點擊、加購與購買。
根據商品資料缺漏與購物行為，建議描述、FAQ及購買指南內容。
highlights_en: The company describes tracking clicks, add-to-carts and purchases by AI source, product and category.
Product-data gaps and shopping behavior inform descriptions, FAQs and buyer guides.
article.why: AI曝光檢查加入交易訊號後，電商團隊可決定先補哪些商品資料，避免只按被提及次數分配內容製作資源。
article.why_en: Transaction signals can help ecommerce teams prioritize product-data repairs rather than allocating content work by mention counts alone.
article.next_step: 選一個有AI引流的商品類別，比較到站、加購與購買的缺口，再把缺失屬性轉成一輪FAQ及描述修訂。
article.next_step_en: Choose a category receiving AI referrals, compare visit-to-cart and purchase gaps, then turn missing attributes into a focused content revision.
article.detail: 答案引擎優化是改善產品在AI答案中的可理解性及出現機會。這次屬公司功能公告，沒有本刊驗證的增量收入結果。編輯建議先把來源辨識與交易記錄核對，確保同一類商品可以比較，再測試補全資料後的變化。即使觀察到AI來源有購買，也不能單憑路徑追蹤認定新增銷售由內容修訂造成。
article.detail_en: Answer engine optimization aims to make products understandable and discoverable in AI answers. This issuer announcement provides no independently verified incremental revenue. Reconcile referral identification with transaction records before comparing categories or testing content changes. Observed AI-referred purchases do not by themselves establish that a revision caused additional sales.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
